QuestInfo.name: The Giant Nependeaths Appear
QuestInfo.0: It seems that something related to the Black Wings is happening in #b#m200000000##k. You should talk to #b#p2012012##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2012012# the fairy says #r#o9300347##k is growing in #b#m200060001##k and wants you to investigate. Enter through the crumbled entrance on the left side of #b#m200000200##k to go to #m200060001#. Eliminate the #o9300347# population there and bring back whatever you find.\r\n\r\n#i4032324# #t4032324# #b#c4032324# / 5#k
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated some #o9300347#s and brought the #t4032324#s you found. #p2012012# has no idea who would do such thing. Her biggest concern now is that #m200000000# will fall...

0.msg: Ugh... My head... I could REALLY use a good night of sleep... Anyway, what brings you here? This is the second time you've come to me, so it must be important.

1.msg: I've heard that strange things are happening in #m200000000#.

2.msg: How'd you know? Recently, some kind of loud noise has been echoing through #m200000000#. None of the fairies can get any sleep!\n

3.msg: I followed the noise to #m200000000#, and it was coming from #b#m200060001##k, but no one can get there. Probably for the best, because #rit was a huge Nependeath#k! It was hundreds of times bigger than your average Nependeath, and it was responsible for all the noise.

4.msg: What caused a Nependeath to grow THAT big? Nependeaths in #m200000000# never get that big... If we're going to come up with a plan, we need to know the cause. Defeat the #r#o9300347##k and find the #bcause#k, will you?

5.msg: The #o9300347# population can be found in #m200060001#. Enter through the crumbled entrance on the left side of #b#m200000200##k. Eliminate some #o9300347# monsters, and bring me anything suspicious. You know what suspicious looks like, right? \r\n\r\n#b(When you accept, you will move immediately to #m920030000#.)

no.0: If you can't help us, then there's nothing we can do about it. Seriously, how can a giant, giant Nependeath like that even exist?

1.0: Did you manage to eliminate the #o9300347#s? Did you find any items that could have caused them to grow so big?

yes.0: #t4032324#? Who gave this to Nependeath? No wonder the Nependeath grew out of control. Wait, that's not the problem!
yes.1: I don't know if you know this, but #m200000000# is a town that floats in the air. However, it has started to sink gradually over the years. If #m200000000# gets heavier, it can sink to the ground.
yes.2: It's not about lack of sleep! Anyway I've got to see if #m200000000# will be okay. It might fall if it gets too heavy. Maybe #b#p2032001##k will know something.

item.0: I asked you to hunt the #r#o9300347#s#k! Enter through the crumbled entrance on the left side of the #b#m200000200##k to get to #b#m200060001##k. And bring back anything that might be a clue! Don't forget!
